labels.image_pull_error: the container image cannot be pulled (wrong tag, missing image, registry authorization)
labels.oom_killed: the container exceeds its memory limit and is killed (OOMKilled, exit code 137)
labels.crash_missing_config: the application starts, then exits because required configuration (an environment variable or a file) is missing or invalid
labels.readiness_probe_failure: the readiness probe fails, so the Pod receives no traffic; this includes a new version whose failing readiness blocks a rollout
labels.liveness_probe_failure: the liveness probe fails, so the kubelet restarts a container that is otherwise working
labels.insufficient_resources: the Pod cannot be scheduled because no node has enough CPU or memory for its requests
labels.missing_configmap: the Pod references a ConfigMap that does not exist, so the container is never created
labels.service_selector_mismatch: the Pods are healthy, but the Service selector matches no Pod labels, so the Service has no endpoints
labels.no_fault: the workloads are healthy; nothing in the cluster explains the report
